subject: Proposal: shift demo to match CTO landing + VP handoff — Storix
raw_messages:
From: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@storix.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Marco Rossi <m.rossi@storix.com>, kimberly.park@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: shift demo to match CTO landing + VP handoff — Storix

Hi Olga,

Quick update from our side — our CTO's travel changed and he now lands late afternoon on Oct 6 (previously expected morning). He strongly prefers to join live for the product demo, and our VP of Engineering wants to do a five-minute handoff at the top. Given the compressed window on Oct 6, would you be able to compress the technical walkthrough into 30 minutes with a 10-minute VP handoff, or alternatively move the demo to Oct 7 mid-morning when there's more breathing room?

We attached the deck we plan to share (PrelimDemoDeck_v2.pdf) so you have the most recent flow. Apologies for the late notice — flights and calendar clashes.

Two constraints to note:
- CTO needs a live Q&A (no recording-only slot)
- VP can only join the first 10 minutes due to another commitment

Thanks for coordinating — let me know what options work on your side.

Best,
Sarah
Director, Product & Strategy
Storix

(attachment: PrelimDemoDeck_v2.pdf)

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: shift demo to match CTO landing + VP handoff — Storix

Kim / Jonas — looping you both for availability and quick ops plan.

Summary: Storix CTO now lands late on Oct 6 and wants to join live. They asked either: compress to a 30-minute session + 10-minute VP handoff on Oct 6 OR move to Oct 7 mid-morning.

My proposal (to send to Storix):
1) Primary: Move to Oct 7, 10:30–11:15 PT — full 35–40 minute walkthrough, CTO can join live, VP can lead a 10-minute intro/hand-off at 10:30.
2) Fallback (if they must keep Oct 6): Oct 6, 16:30–17:10 PT — compress to a 30-minute tech demo + 10-minute VP intro. We'll trim non-essential deep dives and save Q&A for a dedicated follow-up.

Operational notes:
- Need to prepare a compressed deck (I can cut to v3 highlighting only core demos and Q&A slides).
- Jonas: can you be on the 16:15 call to warm up environment if we go Oct 6? Quick KV cache warm and token budget check.
- Kim: please confirm A/V backup (alternate host) and ready to own Q&A moderation if VP has to step off.

If both of you can confirm availability for both proposed times by EOD, I'll reply to Sarah with options and a calendar-conflict transparency note.

Thanks —
Olga
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Marco Rossi <m.rossi@storix.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@storix.com>, kimberly.park@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 08:50:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: shift demo to match CTO landing + VP handoff — Storix

Olga — thanks for the quick response. Short note from my side: the CTO's arrival shifted because his original connection was canceled; he now clears customs ~16:00 on Oct 6 but has about 45 minutes of ground transit to the office. Given that, Oct 7 at 10:30 PT is the *cleanest* option. If Redwood can do Oct 7 we can ensure the CTO attends live without rush and the VP can still do the quick intro.

If Oct 7 is not possible, we can make Oct 6 work but would ask you to limit the demo to 30 minutes (no more than 10 slides of deep technical content) and schedule a 30-minute follow-up technical Q&A later that week.

Appreciate the flexibility — I'll hold both times tentatively until you confirm.

— Marco
VP Partnerships, Storix

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@storix.com>, Marco Rossi <m.rossi@storix.com>
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.com, jonas.weber@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 01 Oct 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Final: Storix demo moved to Oct 7 10:30 PT (CTO live) — calendar invite sent

Hi Sarah and Marco — thanks for the context and for holding both slots.

We can accommodate Oct 7 at 10:30–11:15 PT. I've booked the session and sent a calendar invite to all participants (Google Calendar event — link below). Please treat the invite as the official time.

Plan for Oct 7:
- 10:30–10:40 PT: VP handoff / high-level alignment (Marco or VP to lead)
- 10:40–11:05 PT: Compressed technical demo (we'll focus on integration and observability flows)
- 11:05–11:15 PT: Live CTO Q&A (open discussion)

Action items:
- Olga: upload compressed deck (DemoDeck_v3.pdf) to the Drive link and attach to calendar.
- Jonas: please provision warm-up environment at 10:00 PT; check token budget and KV cache state.
- Kimberly: confirm A/V backup and internal co-hosts.
- Marco / Sarah: confirm whether the CTO prefers screen-sharing from their laptop or would like Redwood to present.

Attachments: DemoDeck_v3.pdf (trimmed to the asked flow).

Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=storix-confirm-20261007
Drive: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/preview/STX-4987/DemoDeck_v3

If anything changes on your side (flight re-routes are the worst), loop me and we'll pivot to the Oct 6 compressed fallback. Otherwise, see you Oct 7.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
